name: top
summary: Monitors processes and system load in real time.
description: Shows a dashboard refreshed every 3 seconds: load average, memory, then the list of processes sorted by CPU use. top is interactive: q quits, M sorts by memory, P by CPU, k sends a signal to a process, 1 shows each core, h shows help.

options.description: Batch mode: non-interactive text output, useful in a script or with a redirection.

examples.explanation: Opens the interactive monitor (q to quit).
A single snapshot in text mode, limited to the first lines.
